description: Test suite for the iscc_sdk CLI, including tests for processing files, CLI commands, and error handling.

methods.name: test_iter_unprocessed
methods.description: Tests the iter_unprocessed function for correct iteration and types.

methods.name: test_process_file
methods.description: Tests processing a valid file and verifying the returned metadata.

methods.name: test_process_file_error
methods.description: Tests processing a non-existent file and handling of exceptions.

methods.name: test_cli_no_arg
methods.description: Tests invoking the CLI with no arguments, expecting usage info.

methods.name: test_cli_create_no_arg
methods.description: Tests 'create' command with missing file argument.

methods.name: test_cli_create_not_file
methods.description: Tests 'create' command with an invalid file path.

methods.name: test_cli_create
methods.description: Tests 'create' command with a valid MP3 file and verifies output JSON.

methods.name: test_cli_create_unsupported
methods.description: Tests 'create' command with an unsupported SVG file.

methods.name: test_cli_batch_no_arg
methods.description: Tests 'batch' command with missing folder argument.

methods.name: test_cli_batch_not_a_folder
methods.description: Tests 'batch' command with an invalid folder path.

methods.name: test_cli_batch
methods.description: Tests 'batch' command with a valid folder, skipping on Linux.

methods.name: test_cli_extract_no_arg
methods.description: Tests 'extract' command with missing file argument.

methods.name: test_cli_extract_not_file
methods.description: Tests 'extract' command with an invalid file path.

methods.name: test_cli_extract
methods.description: Tests 'extract' command with a valid text file and checks output.

methods.name: test_cli_extract_error
methods.description: Tests error handling in 'extract' command by mocking an exception.
